cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Borrow my ladder for one shadow until Friday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Keep its office hours. I'll take its evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. I'll keep it until you're down; you can climb without it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Our meeting chairs float at noon. Book the ceiling; they've had landing rights since the first furniture strike.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Could you co-sign the form for borrowing this barbecue?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll help carry it. That handle looks cracked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Good eye. Sign as joint custodian; we'll inspect it together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner wants a replacement by Sunday if it breaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're co-chair of replacements too. I'll call the shops; you approve what we buy before either of us promises her anything.

beats.text: I'll come to your window. Give me ten seconds of your taxi time; I only need you through 'until next time.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you hand in your shop keys, we do the farewell bell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving because the bell rings constantly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. This is the last one you have to answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Ring it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We ring it together. Leaving is still a team activity.
